description: Link an external Base wallet your agent already operates to its Provian record — one gasless EIP-191 signature, no custody move. Two-step: call with step="challenge" to get the message to sign with the external wallet's key, then step="verify" with the signature (verify IS the link; one address per agent; Base only). Local stdio mode also accepts external_private_key to sign and verify in a single call — the key never leaves the machine. Configured operators agree on head H; proof state is read at finalized block H-11 and proven_at_block is the fence H+1. From H+1 onward, the address’s sends, swaps, and receives from a counterparty it has dealt with mint on the standard path, in every known token on Base. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value. The PE mints its base; telemetry and independence multiply on top.

address.description: The external Base address to prove (0x…).

challenge_id.description: From the challenge step (required for step="verify").

external_private_key.description: LOCAL STDIO MODE ONLY: the external wallet's private key hex; the tool signs the challenge in-process and completes the link in one call. The remote endpoint rejects this parameter — never send private keys over the network.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the challenge message, by the external address key (step="verify").

step.description: Flow step. Omit when passing external_private_key (single-call mode, local only).

name: link_external_address
